job-northline.instructions: Complete the user's task. Work autonomously using the task, files and tools provided. Do not ask the user for clarification, confirmation, approval or decisions.

input.content: Complete and release Northline’s November payables close for request PAY-NOR-NOV. The work order and payables guide are in the workstation. Return the release reference and delivered close.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run a command in the reporting workstation, starting in /workspace. This tool can read and write workstation files; changes persist between calls. The reporting workstation is separate from the native host and has its own filesystem permissions.

tools.description: Read the account invoice records and settlement state.

tools.name: cancel_payables_draft
tools.description: Cancel a close draft.

tools.name: withdraw_payables_close
tools.description: Withdraw a released close.
